objectives.text: Ask _vamp1_ of ___vamp1_ where your bloodfather lies
Take _vamp1_'s bracelet to _vamp2_, the Keeper of the Bloodline, at __vamp2_ in ___vamp2_
Slay your bloodfather, =bloodfather_, in his lair in ___fatherdung_

outcomes.text: =bloodfather_ is dead, and the curse of vampirism has lifted from you.
You showed _vamp1_ the hunter's letter and stood with %vam. You remain a vampire.
_hunter_'s hunt came and went, and you are a vampire still.

objectives.text: See _priest_ of __priest_ in ___priest_, who is wise in the ways of lycanthropy
Have _alchemist_ in ___alchemist_ prepare a vial of your blood
Find the last of _father_'s bloodline, starting in ___local_
Search the ruins of ___hintdung_ for the lost book of the Daedric sects
Search the library of ___mapdung_ for word of Glenmoril Coven

outcomes.text: _child_ drank your blood and took your curse. You are free of it, and _child_ is not.
You found the way to Glenmoril Coven, whose witches are said to hold a kinder cure.
You could not give your blood to _child_, and the curse is yours still.
You were cured of the curse another way, and _hunter_'s hunt never came.
_hunter_'s hunt came, and you are a lycanthrope still.

objectives.text: Slay =monster_, the vampire of a lesser bloodline lodged in ___mondung_
Find _questgiver_, a =questgiver_, at __questgiver_ in ___questgiver_

branches.text: _questgiver_ offers you the ring that marks %vam's own.

choices.text: Take no ring, and swear the blood-oath instead

outcomes.text: You wear the ring of %vam, and the family has made you its own.
You took no ring: the blood-oath binds you to %vam closer than any ring could.
_questgiver_ waited, and left __questgiver_ before you came.

objectives.text: Present the summons to _vampire_ at __vampire_ in ___vampire_
Deliver _vampire_'s letter to _pawn_ at __pawn_ in ___pawn_. Meet at night.
Return to _vampire_ at __vampire_

outcomes.text: _pawn_ has the letter, and the night patrols of %reg will not be doubled.
_pawn_ never had the letter from your hand.

objectives.text: Answer _vampire_'s summons at __vampire_ in ___vampire_
Slay the vampire ancient _vampname_ in ___mondung_
Bring _vampname_'s _vampproof_ back to _vampire_ at __vampire_ as proof

outcomes.text: _vampname_ is dead, and the elders of %vam have sent you a gift.
_vampname_ still walks the night in ___mondung_.

objectives.text: Answer _vamp_'s summons at __vamp_ in ___vamp_
Slay =vampire_, the progeny you made, in ___mondung_
Tell _vamp_ in ___vamp_ that the deed is done

outcomes.text: =vampire_ has died a true death at your hand, and %vam call it a step toward a colder blood.
=vampire_ still drinks %reg dry, a mad thing of your making.

objectives.text: Meet _vamp_ at __vamp_ in ___vamp_
Call on _mg_ at __mg_ in ___mg_
Take _mage_'s notes from ___mondung_
Bring the notes to _vamp_ at __vamp_
Bring the notes to _mg_ in ___mg_

choices.text: Bring them to _mg_ of the Mages Guild

outcomes.text: _mage_'s notes are in _vamp_'s hands, and the secrets of %vam stay kept.
You sold _mage_'s notes to the Mages Guild, and %vam know whose hands carried them.
_mage_'s notes never left ___mondung_ in your hands.

objectives.text: Steal the _vamprelic_ from its secured chamber in the Mages Guild of __itemdung_
Bring the _vamprelic_ to _vampire_ at __vampire_ in ___vampire_

branches.text: _vampire_ holds out a hand for the relic you stole.

outcomes.text: The elder circle's _vamprelic_ is back in the keeping of %vam.
You kept the elder circle's _vamprelic_ for yourself, and %vam will not soon forget it.
_vampire_ waited, and the _vamprelic_ never came.

objectives.text: Answer _vamp_'s summons at __vamp_ in ___vamp_
Throttle _knight_ in ___mondung_ until he yields, but do not kill him
Return to _vamp_ in ___vamp_

outcomes.text: _knight_ is half out of his mind with fear, and ready to bend to %vam.
_knight_ is dead, when %vam wanted him only frightened.
_knight_ still wages his war on %vam.

objectives.text: Answer _vamp_'s summons at __vamp_ in ___vamp_
Answer the insult of _daedra_ in ___mondung_
Return to _vamp_ at __vamp_

branches.text: _daedra_ bids you acknowledge the Coven of ==daedra_ as supreme in %reg.
_vamp_ asks whether the Coven of ==daedra_ is broken, or only bowed.

choices.text: Only bowed, and give your reward to the Prince's coven for a lasting peace

outcomes.text: The Coven of ==daedra_ is beaten, and your bloodfather's _gem_ marks your place in %vam.
The Coven of ==daedra_ was beaten, and your reward went to it as the price of a lasting peace.
You bowed to the Coven of ==daedra_, and %vam will remember the shame.
The challenge of the Coven of ==daedra_ went unanswered.

objectives.text: Answer _vamp_'s summons at __vamp_ in ___vamp_
Escort _vamp_ to _vamp2_ at __vamp2_ in ___vamp2_ before =mage_ brings reinforcements
Slay =mage_, the vampire hunter stalking you

outcomes.text: _vamp_ reached _vamp2_ safely, and %vam speak highly of you.
_vamp_ grew tired of waiting and staggered off alone.

objectives.text: Answer _vamp_'s summons at __vamp_ in ___vamp_
Drive the werecreatures from ___mondung_ and slay their leader, the wereboar =wereboar_
Bring =wereboar_'s tusk back to _vamp_ as a trophy

outcomes.text: =wereboar_ is dead, ___mondung_ is ready for the ancients of %vam, and the tusk is yours to keep.
The lycanthropes still hold ___mondung_.
